official_definition: Dark Unleash: 2 [LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks) Destroy opposing Spirits/Ultimates up to a total of 12000 BP. This effect can only be prevented by "Heavy Armor"/"Ultra Armor". Then, when your Field & Trash has At least seven Red cards, by putting two cores from your Red Grandwalker Nexus to this Spirit, send an opposing Life to the Void.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Dark Unleash] or [Dark Unleash: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Dark Unleash]", "give [Dark Unleash]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mutates game state as specified by official effect text.
